chapter.name: IEEE Computer Society Student Chapter
chapter.logo_alt: IEEE Computer Society Nirma University Logo
chapter.description: The IEEE Computer Society Student Chapter at Nirma University operates under the global IEEE Computer Society. Founded to empower tomorrow's engineers and leaders, the chapter drives student collaboration in cutting-edge fields such as computer science, quantum computing, computer vision, cybersecurity, and beyond.

ieee_cs.title: IEEE Computer Society
ieee_cs.description: The IEEE Computer Society is a global organization for computing professionals. Celebrating its 80th anniversary in 2026, it advances the field through high-impact conferences, publications, and professional initiatives connecting leaders across all career stages.

highlights.title: SC24
highlights.description: Brought together more than 18,000 high-performance computing experts.

highlights.title: CVPR 2026
highlights.description: Attracted 12,200 attendees representing 84 countries and regions. Set new records for attendance and paper submissions, showcasing breakthroughs in computer vision, artificial intelligence (AI), autonomous systems, and embodied AI/robotics.

highlights.title: Quantum Week 2026
highlights.description: Served as a flagship global platform for quantum engineering and computing, bringing together more than 2,300 attendees from across the international quantum community.

nirma_chapter.title: Nirma University Chapter
nirma_chapter.description: Upholding its parent organization's commitment to innovation, the IEEE Computer Society Chapter at Nirma University was established in 2025. The chapter has made a strong impact by hosting key events such as HackDays Ahmedabad and fostering student technical research and collaboration.
nirma_chapter.image_alt: IEEE CS Nirma Chapter Group Photo

goals.title: Foster Technical Innovation & Research Excellence
goals.description: Empower students to engage in cutting-edge computing research, deep learning model replication, and open-source software engineering.

goals.title: Promote Student Collaboration in Emerging Fields
goals.description: Cultivate an active peer-learning community centered on key domains, including Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Cybersecurity, Health AI, and Quantum Computing.

goals.title: Build a Collaborative Learning Community Beyond the Classroom
goals.description: Provide a dedicated environment where students can learn, work, and collaborate as a cohesive team outside of traditional coursework.
